title: retro-games component diagram
description: The repository's parts: the games, the workflows that ship them, the sign-in library they vendor, the tooling for making and documenting them, and the services outside the repository they rely on.

components.name: retro-games
components.responsibility: Six games made with the help of AI, and everything needed to test, ship and document them.

components.name: Games
components.responsibility: Rally, Shatterbelt, Hivestorm, Samosa and Gambit, played in the browser, and LodeStar, a desktop game.

components.name: Workflows
components.responsibility: Check every pull request and deploy each changed game from main.

components.name: Sign-in library (vendor/icelander-auth)
components.responsibility: Checks icelander.net's sign-in for every game's Worker; a copy kept identical to the icelander.net repository's.

components.name: Clean-room skills (.claude/skills)
components.responsibility: The process and scripts for making a clean-room remake and checking it.

components.name: Skills and knowledge catalogue (Meta/Agents)
components.responsibility: How .dev files are written, and the validators that check them; copied from human-assisted-software-development.

components.name: Games hub
components.responsibility: icelander.net's games Worker, in another repository: sign-in pages on this host, /me, play time, the multiplayer lobby and the online match relay.

components.name: icelander.net login service
components.responsibility: Says who is signed in to icelander.net and which games: roles they hold; reached through the ACCOUNTS service binding.

components.name: Cloudflare
components.responsibility: Runs every game's Worker, D1 database and static assets, and Gambit's Durable Objects.

components.name: GitHub
components.responsibility: Hosts the repository, runs the workflows and holds main to pull requests.

components.name: Resend
components.responsibility: Sends Gambit's invitation emails, when the Worker is configured for it.

relationships.description: Every web game's Worker checks the sign-in with it.
Asks the login service through the ACCOUNTS service binding.
Online matches through its relay; /me and play time from the browser.
